item.title: Snowmobilers who died in Seeley Lake ID'd as Pablo, Belgrade men
item.description: SEELEY LAKE – A day after two snowmobilers died in the frigid water of Seeley Lake, authorities said crossing the icy surface was "not uncommon."

item.title: Daines, Tester try to use Keystone XL bill to block Air Force jet range
item.description: The congressional chess match over the Keystone XL pipeline added some Twister rules Friday when Montana’s senators linked it to a proposed U.S. Air Force fighter jet training range.

item.title: Keystone XL passes Senate; Daines, Tester vote yes
item.description: Both Montana’s senior Democratic Sen. Jon Tester and junior Republican Sen. Steve Daines voted to approve the Keystone XL pipeline Thursday, but the delegation split on the locally important Land and Water Conservation Fund.

item.title: Daines calls for wide-ranging forest reform in phone-in town hall meeting
item.description: Montana needs timber management that addresses all 10 of the state’s national forests, Sen. Steve Daines told listeners on a statewide conference call.

item.title: Marshall Woods project hinges on Rattlesnake logging
item.description: A 13,000-acre project to revitalize the forest in Missoula’s Rattlesnake and Marshall drainages may hinge on 225 acres of commercial logging.

item.title: Montana Conservation Corps workers learn to lead on Rattlesnake trail
item.description: Jessica Johnson looked up and discovered she was the only one holding a quarter-ton log in place along the trail.

item.title: Video shows mother bear rushing at tourists in Yellowstone
item.description: BILLINGS – Dramatic video captured by a Montana wildlife official shows a mother black bear with cubs running toward a knot of camera-clicking tourists as the animals try to cross a bridge in Yellowstone National Park.
